name: hope
description: Understand pull requests, write clear prose, and save shared Hope preferences. Requires Node.js 20 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Practical ways for people and AI to work better together
interface.longDescription: Diff explains code changes with evidence for your decision. Write helps you draft, edit, or review clear prose without losing its meaning. Settings saves the language and theme Hope should use.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope:diff to explain the current pull request.
Use $hope:write to make this text clear and direct.
